Coordinating a consistent customer experience after a merger

Bringing multiple digital assets together around one business identity.

The objective

Establish an integrated brand experience following a major asset-management merger.

Mak’s contribution

Mak led a 45-person team over 16 weeks, coordinating changes across websites, content, user experience, search and customer-relationship systems.

The outcome

The transition was completed ahead of schedule and under budget, establishing an integrated experience across the affected digital assets.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Coordinating interdependent workstreams during a business transition while maintaining a clear customer-facing objective.
